_comment: Single source of truth for 360 reconstruction quality presets. Read by the pf360 worker AND by the PointForge viewer (Reconstruction wizard). Every key maps to a real backend flag - see pf360/nerfstudio_backend.py. framesPerSecond is converted to a target frame count from the selected time window and clamped to [minFrames, maxFrames].

preview.label: Preview
preview.description: Fast check of whether the footage reconstructs at all. Standard Splatfacto, quarter-resolution training images, few frames, short training.
preview.costNote: Lowest GPU time and VRAM. Expect a soft, low-detail result.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Standard Splatfacto at half-resolution training images, ~3 sampled frames per second, 8 perspective views per frame.
balanced.costNote: Moderate GPU time. Typical 8-12 GB GPUs handle it for short clips.

high.label: High Quality
high.description: Splatfacto-Big (lower cull alpha + densify thresholds = more Gaussians), full-resolution perspective images, 14 views per frame, longer training.
high.costNote: Highest GPU time and VRAM; many more Gaussians. Reduce frames or raise the downscale factor if training runs out of memory.
